name: AmbiDB
description: AmbiDB is a synthetic dataset designed to reflect the ambiguity of real-world schema linking in large-scale multi-database environments, enabling more realistic evaluation of Text-to-SQL schema linking methods.
reputation: A niche but useful synthetic benchmark for Text-to-SQL schema linking, mainly of interest to researchers studying realistic multi-database ambiguity rather than broad community leaderboard use.
notes: Synthetic dataset for schema linking evaluation in large-scale multi-database Text-to-SQL tasks.
